title: Attraction Totale All-in-One Hair & Body Shower Gel

details.description: A charismatic man needs a sensual fragrance to match his calibre. The Brut Attraction Totale All-In-One Hair & Body Shower Gel is a luxury shower gel enriched with a blend of citrus fruit notes and white musk that leaves a lasting impression. Lather it all over and show the world, you still got it. This formula gives you 3 in 1 performance.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Wet your skin in the shower or bath.
2. Lather some of the body wash on your hands and use a loofah or a washcloth to apply it to your skin.
3. Rinse it off and pat dry with a towel.
4. Don't rub, because rubbing takes away moisture.
